mistake_content: The test_03 method is missing its required docstring that must contain a description of what the test verifies and a TestRails link. According to HPX automation standards (Section 7: TEST FILE ANATOMY & CONVENTIONS), every test method must include a docstring with the test description and TestRails URL in the format: 'TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/<case_id>'. The removed docstring contained: 'Verify the buttons of cancel shortcut creation pop up window.' and 'TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/48'
solution:
Add the complete docstring back to the test_03 method. The corrected code should be:

```python
def test_03_verify_the_position_of_the_buttons_on_the_cancel_shortcut_creation_pop_up_window_C48(self):
    """
    Verify the buttons of cancel shortcut creation pop up window.
    TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/48
    """
    assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()
    assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_cancel_shortcut_go_back_btn()
```

This ensures compliance with HPX automation documentation standards where every test method must have a docstring containing:
1. A clear description of what the test verifies
2. A TestRails link in the standard format for traceability

The docstring format follows the template from the Knowledge Base (Section 7: TEST FILE ANATOMY & CONVENTIONS) which mandates this structure for all test methods to maintain proper documentation and test case traceability.
